verdict.rationale: Linear documents that its GraphQL API can be explored and queried in Apollo Studio with no download or login, and that it supports schema introspection. That gives users an interactive reference where they can run live queries, but there is no evidence of curated runnable examples. missing for 10: documented pre-built runnable example queries, in-depth first-party docs on the explorer experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Our GraphQL API is explorable and queryable via [Apollo Studio](https://studio.apollographql.com/public/Linear-API/variant/current/home), no download or log in required.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
